notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone:
We have updated the game, Added hints for loading games, Optimized some game content, Can better experience the game, I wish you a happy game !

notes.title: Questions about the game
notes.content:
Hello everyone:
We noticed feedback that some players can't enter the game, Wait one minute when opening the game, Don't click the mouse, Do nothing else, Game loading takes time, which is related to computer performance
I wish you a happy game !
